introduction: At the advanced level, examiners focus heavily on the specific latitudes (Channels) dividing the Andaman, Nicobar, and Lakshadweep islands, as well as highly specific disputed lines with Pakistan.

core_concepts.title: 8 Degree Channel
core_concepts.description:
Location: Between **Maldives and Minicoy (India)**. 
Key Feature: It separates the independent island nation of Maldives from Minicoy (the southernmost island of India's Lakshadweep archipelago).

core_concepts.title: 9 Degree Channel
core_concepts.description:
Location: Between **Minicoy and Main Lakshadweep**. 
Key Feature: It separates Minicoy from the rest of the Lakshadweep island group.

core_concepts.title: 10 Degree Channel
core_concepts.description:
Location: Between **Andaman and Nicobar** (Specifically between Little Andaman and Car Nicobar). 
Key Feature: It is the most frequently asked maritime channel, located in the Bay of Bengal.

core_concepts.title: Duncan Passage
core_concepts.description:
Location: Between **South Andaman and Little Andaman**. 
Key Feature: It is located north of the 10 Degree channel and separates the Great Andaman group from Little Andaman.

core_concepts.title: 24th Parallel
core_concepts.description:
Location: Rann of Kutch (Gujarat). 
Key Feature: Pakistan claims that this line should be the boundary between India and Pakistan in the Sir Creek region, but **India strongly rejects this claim**.

important_entities.name: Sir Creek
important_entities.significance: It is a 96-km strip of water disputed between India (Gujarat) and Pakistan (Sindh province) that opens up into the Arabian Sea.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: The Precise Location of the 10 Degree Channel
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: If the options are made difficult, merely knowing 'Andaman and Nicobar' won't be enough. The precise answer is that it separates **'Little Andaman'** from **'Car Nicobar'**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation:
8 Degree = M-M (Maldives & Minicoy). 
9 Degree = M-L (Minicoy & Lakshadweep). 
10 Degree = A-N (Andaman & Nicobar).

exam_strategy_tips: A highly repeated question in NDA/CDS and SSC CGL: 'The Duncan Passage is situated between?' Answer: South Andaman and Little Andaman.
